title: CLMS VLCC Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) Europe 10m yearly V1 (COG)
description: The Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) dataset provides information on the length of the main annual crop growing season, expressed in days (range: 40–366). The duration is derived from the detected emergence and harvest dates of the main growing season. Information on growing season length and its variations over time offers valuable insights into how crop seasons are affected by extreme weather conditions and climate change at regional and national level. This layer is only generated for pixels classified as annual cropland. This dataset is provided annually starting with 2017 in 10-metre rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 × 100 km tiles covering the EEA-38 countries. The HRL Main Crop Duration product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs).
